research.schema: Chat completions messages content text then image_url with PNG data URL; structured output via existing text helper
research.limitations: Live paid provider unavailable. OpenAI docs fetch HTTP403. No OCR accuracy or desktop monitoring claim.

contracts.state: describe_dom and compose_page_state preserve DOM vs vision attribution and noninteractive collector visible_alerts frame/bounds metadata; heuristic confidence not calibrated
contracts.recovery: reload separate from custom Refresh; host BROWSER_RECOVERY_POLICY canonical origins, complete DOM error coverage and no sensitive/nonempty data incl BrowserCore all-document safety
contracts.agent_options: interpret_visual=false; on_progress callable; recovery_policy host-only dict. No visual_summary flag synonym; visual_summary is result dict only
contracts.visual_result: source vision, state, summary, visible_text <=8x240, observed regions <=8, recovery_recommended, self_reported_confidence uncalibrated, observation_id, capture_scope
contracts.progress: seq increasing, checkpoint observe/needs_user/reobserve/blocked/done/cancelled, step executed action count, status, page_state structural state/source/coverage_status/recovery_available/approval_required/capture_scope; no typed secrets/raw text/screenshots; identical checkpoints debounced 250ms
contracts.progress_errors: Callback failure disables further callbacks, stops input and returns progress_error plus error_diagnostic; terminal delivery failures also return result without throwing/repeating
contracts.browser_errors: BrowserError serialized lazily by existing error_payload in error_diagnostic preserving actual changed-region/reobserve info; unexpected errors retain sanitized type only
contracts.rendered_recovery_evidence: Only observation rendered text or collector visible_alerts can establish rendered_text_match for approval waiver; accessible_control_label_match never grants reload authority; role alert/status accessible-name fallback removed.
contracts.visual_region_coverage: 256 region cap prioritizes screenshot grid then canvas/visual then DOM; prompt and result region_coverage disclose total/offered/omitted/limit/priority; observed region IDs only.
contracts.nontext_reload_fallback: Select/combobox/listbox/checkbox/radio observed presence conservatively requires approval, including cached observations missing document safety metadata.
